meta.title: Carolo Canis Ltd. | Dog Training & Cynology
meta.description: Dog training, equipment and food, and cynology advice in Karlovac, Zagreb and Rijeka. 30 years of experience — an individual approach for every dog and owner.
meta.ogTitle: Carolo Canis Ltd. — dog training and cynology
meta.keywords: dog training, cynology, obedience, Karlovac, Zagreb, Rijeka, Carolo Canis, puppy training, socialization

hero.lede: Carolo Canis Ltd. is a small, tightly focused company working in cynology — dog training, trade in dog equipment and food, and cynology advice. That advice draws on the credentials of a working-dog judge and a court expert in cynology (2009–2017).

items.education: Education for owners who want to advance personally in cynology
items.gov: Cooperation with state and local government on dog-related regulations and projects

about.title: About
about.lead: Many enter the world of cynology unprepared, curious and sincere — yet, as in so much else, various problems sometimes catch them on the very first steps, and with time some grow too large.
about.p1: A tradition spanning more than thirty years gives us the freedom to offer you, as a company, help so that everything becomes easier, faster and better.
about.p2: Through these pages you can get to know us and our partners, find answers to some of your questions, resolve basic problems with your own dog, and enjoy cynology if it becomes more than a pastime.
credentials: Selector of the Croatian national team 1996–2001

individual.title: Individual approach
individual.body: Through an individual approach, every dog and owner receive their own plan and activity timeline tailored to their needs and capabilities. No two dogs are alike, nor are their owners' requirements identical.

session.title: Open weekly slot
session.body: Course dates are arranged according to availability and weather conditions, and adjusted to your progress.

exam.title: Training exam
exam.body: After the course we recommend taking exams at several levels — confirmation of success for you and the community you live in, and proof of a responsible owner toward society.

payment.title: Flexible payment
payment.body: Course fees follow your progress through the phases of training. Payments are made in instalments; missed sessions are not charged — the price covers the full programme through to its completion.

risk.title: Higher-risk work
risk.body: In some cases prices are set according to injury risk and the complexity of the work processes, and are agreed directly with the client.

opinions.title: Expert opinions
opinions.body: Charged according to time spent and use of technical and professional resources: topic preparation, analysis and alignment with regulations and the legal framework, drafting the opinion, and dependent costs.

events.title: Event organisation
events.body: Organisation of professional events is charged according to dependent costs: time frame and duration, location and transport, professional staff, and venue organisation.
